text: Villiers Street, in the Portlands, is an important site for jobs and employment in the East End. However due to a lack of parking regulations there is an issue with long-term parking and storage of vehicles. Implementing pay-and-display on Villiers will ensure that businesses have spots and cut down on long-term parking. I am asking you to support this request.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. Transportation Services to bring forward a report and accompanying by-laws implementing pay-and-display parking on Villiers Street between Don Roadway and Cherry Street.
